title.zh: 将安蒂波洛市 San Jose 描笼涯一所国立中学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Maximo L. Gatlabayan Memorial 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Antipolo National High School - Paenaan Annex in Barangay San Jose, City of Antipolo From the Antipolo National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Maximo L. Gatlabayan Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Paenaan của Trường Trung học Antipolo Quốc gia tại Barangay San Jose, Thành phố Antipolo khỏi Trường Trung học Antipolo Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Maximo L. Gatlabayan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Paenaan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Antipolo แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Jose เมือง Antipolo ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Antipolo แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Maximo L. Gatlabayan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Paenaan, Sekolah Menengah Antipolo Nasional di Barangay San Jose, Kota Antipolo dari Sekolah Menengah Antipolo Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Memorial Maximo L. Gatlabayan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Paenaan, Sekolah Menengah Antipolo Kebangsaan di Barangay San Jose, Bandar Antipolo daripada Sekolah Menengah Antipolo Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Memorial Maximo L. Gatlabayan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Antipolo National High School - Paenaan Annex in Barangay San Jose, City of Antipolo is hereby separated from the Antipolo National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Maximo L. Gatlabayan Memorial National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Antipolo National High School - Paenaan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Maximo L. Gatlabayan Memorial National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Maximo L. Gatlabayan Memorial National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Antipolo National High School - Paenaan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
